First time here? Walk through an example ↓

“I’m in 85083, I can drive 15 minutes, and I’m not sure what I want.”

  1. Set your starting area. Enter 85083, choose Drive time · minutes, then 15 minutes.
  2. Click Find restaurants. The cooking indicator shows what’s happening. You can cancel if you change your mind.
  3. Rate a few dishes while we search. Burger? Yum! Sushi? Nah. Pasta? Hmm, maybe. You can stop anytime; all 24 are optional. To change an earlier answer, expand Your food choices under the quiz and choose a different rating. Undo restores your last change.
  4. Click See restaurants when results are ready. Your preferred cuisines move up the list. Keep rating to change the order; map pins match the numbered cards.
  5. Check the place. A green Local badge means we found published evidence of local ownership and operation. Tap it for the source. Local ownership unverified means we don’t know.
  6. Go eat. Open Details & map for the website and hours, tap the heart to save it, or Let’s go for directions. Choose for me picks from your results.

You can also rate dishes first and press Show my matches. It starts a search if needed. After changing your ZIP or travel limit, press Find restaurants again.

Distances start at the ZIP center, not your exact address. Driving times exclude live traffic. Food photos are inspiration; cuisine matching does not confirm a specific dish is on today’s menu.

One-time setup: connect Geoapify to enable restaurant search.
